sqlMap.select: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT KEY_8 AS EXPIRE_DATE FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'TOKEN' AND TARGET = 'KRINNO0066') >= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN 'true' ELSE 'false' END TOKEN_VAL, KEY_7 AS TOKEN FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'TOKEN' AND TARGET = 'KRINNO0066'
SELECT KEY_7 AS TOKEN FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'TOKEN' AND TARGET = 'KRINNO0066'
sqlMap.update: MERGE INTO ICOMTRXL A USING ( SELECT #token# AS KEY_7 FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND A.DOC_NAME = 'TOKEN' AND A.TARGET = 'KRINNO0066' ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET KEY_7 = #token#, KEY_8 = #expireDate#, KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( DOC_NAME, TARGET, KEY_1, KEY_2, KEY_3, KEY_4, KEY_5, KEY_6, KEY_7, KEY_8, KEY_9, KEY_10 ) VALUES ( 'TOKEN', 'KRINNO0066', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', ' ', #token#, #expireDate#, ' ', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') )
sqlMap.select: SELECT CODE AS IDX , TEXT1 AS NAME , NVL(TEXT2,0) AS SJIDX FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'KRINNO0066' AND TYPE = 'M104' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND VALUE1 = '0'
sqlMap.update: UPDATE ICOMCOD2 SET VALUE1 = #isSuccess# WHERE COMPANY_CODE = 'KRINNO0066' AND TYPE = 'M104' AND FLAG = 'Y' AND VALUE1 = '0'
UPDATE EAI.IF_INNON_ITEM_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'T' WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N'
sqlMap.select: SELECT BUYER_ITEM_NO AS IDX, MAKER_CODE AS BRANDIDX, ITEM_NO AS CODE, DESCRIPTION AS NAME, UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT, VOLUME, CAS_NO AS CASNO, MSDS_URL AS MSDS, IMG_URL AS IMAGEURL, UNIT_PRICE AS PRICE, MIN_ORDER_QTY AS MINQTY, PUR_UNIT_QTY AS MULTIPLEQTY, TYPE, SPECIFICATION AS DES, STATUS FROM EAI.IF_INNON_ITEM_SEND WHERE IF_FLAG = 'T'
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_INNON_ITEM_SEND SET IF_FLAG = #result_flag#, IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE IF_FLAG = 'T'
sqlMap.select: SELECT DISTINCT TARGET AS BUYER, KEY_5 AS IDX FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO_DEL' AND TARGET = 'KRINNO0066' AND KEY_3 = 'DEL' AND KEY_9 = 'N' ORDER BY BUYER,IDX

SELECT TARGET AS BUYER, KEY_5 AS IDX, KEY_6 AS ITEM_IDX, (SELECT DECODE(STATUS,'D','A','P') FROM ICOMPRHD WHERE BUYER = TARGET AND PR_NO = KEY_1) AS TYPE FROM ICOMTRXL WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO_DEL' AND TARGET = #BUYER# AND KEY_3 = 'DEL' AND KEY_5 = #IDX# AND KEY_9 = 'N' ORDER BY BUYER,IDX,TYPE,ITEM_IDX
sqlMap.update: UPDATE ICOMTRXL A SET KEY_9 = 'D' WHERE DOC_NAME = 'ORDER_TRK' AND TARGET = 'KRINNO0066' AND KEY_3 IN ('2_DO', '3_IV') AND KEY_1 IN (SELECT PO_NO FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = 'KRINNO0066' AND PO_NO IN A.KEY_1 AND (SUBSTRB(TRIM(LEGACY_PO_NO),1,2) IN ('PR','PM') OR LEGACY_PO_NO IS NULL)) AND KEY_9 = 'N'
sqlMap.select: SELECT DISTINCT TARGET AS BUYER, KEY_5 AS IDX FROM ICOMTRXL A WHERE DOC_NAME = 'ORDER_TRK' AND TARGET = 'KRINNO0066' AND KEY_3 IN ('2_DO', '3_IV') AND KEY_1 IN (SELECT PO_NO FROM ICOMPODT WHERE BUYER = 'KRINNO0066' AND PO_NO IN A.KEY_1 AND STATUS != 'D' AND LEGACY_PO_NO IS NOT NULL AND SUBSTRB(TRIM(LEGACY_PO_NO),1,2) NOT IN ('PR','PM')) AND KEY_9 = 'N' ORDER BY BUYER,IDX

SELECT TARGET AS BUYER, KEY_5 AS IDX, KEY_6 AS ITEM_IDX, CASE WHEN KEY_3 = '2_DO' THEN '0' ELSE '1' END STATUS , (SELECT MAX(TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(BUYER_DS_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD')) FROM ICOMPORS WHERE BUYER = A.TARGET AND PO_NO = A.KEY_1 AND PO_SEQ = A.KEY_2 AND BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.KEY_7) AS DUE_DATE FROM ICOMTRXL A WHERE DOC_NAME = 'ORDER_TRK' AND TARGET = #BUYER# AND KEY_3 IN ('2_DO', '3_IV') AND KEY_5 = #IDX# AND KEY_9 = 'N' ORDER BY BUYER,IDX,ITEM_IDX,STATUS
sqlMap.update: UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'Y', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'ORDER_TRK' AND TARGET = #BUYER# AND KEY_3 IN ('2_DO', '3_IV') AND KEY_5 = #IDX# AND KEY_9 = 'N'
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'Y', KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO_DEL' AND TARGET = #BUYER# AND KEY_3 = 'DEL' AND KEY_5 = #IDX# AND KEY_9 = 'N'
UPDATE ICOMTRXL SET KEY_9 = 'E', KEY_7 = #MSG#, KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE DOC_NAME = 'PO_DEL' AND TARGET = #BUYER# AND KEY_3 = 'DEL' AND KEY_5 = #IDX# AND KEY_9 = 'N'
sqlMap.select: SELECT LEGACY_PO_NO AS IDX, LEGACY_PO_SEQ AS ITEMIDX, BUYER_ITEM_NO AS MROPRODUCTIDX, INV_NO AS INVOICENO, INV_SEQ AS INVOICEITEMNO, ITEM_QTY AS QTY, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(INV_DATE,'YYYY-MM-DD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS INVOICEDATE, STATUS FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND WHERE BUYER = 'KRINNO0066' AND IF_FLAG = 'N'
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_INV_SEND SET IF_FLAG = #result_flag#, IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS') where IF_FLAG = 'N' AND BUYER = 'KRINNO0066' AND INV_NO = #invoiceNo# AND INV_SEQ = #invoiceItemNo# AND STATUS = #status#
